Näin Nokian Helsingin pörssissä alkanut jyrkkä alamäki jyrkkeni New Yorkin pörssissä tuntuvasti lisää. Helsingin pörssissä Nokian torstain päätöshinnaksi tuli 7,23 euroa 9,7 prosentin pudotuksen jälkeen.

items.title: Chris Pratt vahvisti Star-Lordin palaavan Marvelin elokuviin: ”Se on varmaa”

Näyttelijän mukaan asian eteen on tehty jo ”reippaasti töitä”. ”Minulla on mainio suhde Marvelin Kevin Feigeen ja Lou D’Espositoon, joiden kanssa olen käynyt keskusteluja paluusta. items.title: Node.js Brotli Decoder Bug Could Allow Remote Code Execution in All Supported Versions
items.summary: Node.js released security updates on October 21 for its three supported release lines, 22.x, 24.x and 26.x, fixing 10 flaws. The most serious is a bug in the Brotli decompression code that Node.js bundles, which the project says can allow remote code execution, meaning an attacker could run code of their choosing on the affected system. Each supported line has one fixed version: 22.23.4 and 24.22.1 on the long-term support lines, and 26.12.1 on the current line. Node.js 20.x and earlier have reached end of life and will not receive the fix, so they should be moved to a supported line. The Brot…

items.title: Exploring the Risks and Impacts of AI on Vulnerability Discovery and Exploitation
items.summary: As we hear a lot of noise about AI’s impact on vulnerability discovery and exploitation, I found the need to compartmentalize the risks. So, I took it upon myself to build categories that provide a mental framework for the risks, impact, and evidence AI poses for vulnerabilities and exploitation. Most of these risks aren't new. AI makes the capabilities behind each one more accessible and accelerates how quickly attackers can use them. A growing risk category is AI-assisted vulnerability discovery: AI tools, including frontier models and purpose-built harnesses for finding vulnerabilities, hav…

They credited researchers at Calif, OpenAI, and Wiz with finding the security holes between August and September. VCO is a web-based management portal that helps administrators configure, monitor, and manage VeloCloud SD-WANs (Software-Defined Wide Area Networks) and associated edge devices. Tracked as CVE-2026-114625, this critical-severity flaw can allow attackers with basic privileges, access to the VCO web interface, and a valid authenticated session to escalate privileges through low-complexity SQL injection attacks that don't require user interac…

items.title: WordPress Core <= 7.0.2 - Authenticated (Contributor+) Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Quick Edit
items.summary: Classification: Important, Solution: Official Fix, Exploit Maturity: Not Defined, CVSSv3.1: 4.9, CVEs: CVE-2026-114570, Summary: WordPress Core is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Quick Edit in all versions up to, and including, 7.0.2 due to insufficient escaping of user display names. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a higher privileged user accesses the affected administrative screens. This issue only affects sites with a large number of users.

items.title: The Current Landscape of OAuth Attacks
items.summary: As enterprises continue to roll out multi-factor authentication (MFA), attackers have adapted. Rather than only stealing credentials, attackers have shifted to stealing Open Authorization (OAuth) tokens, the keys that govern what applications can do on your behalf. Adversaries are already accelerating these attacks by using dynamic evasion code, phishing-as-a-service (PhaaS) templates and LLM-generated brand impersonations. Because OAuth attacks occur at the authorization layer after user authentication, stolen access and refresh tokens bypass MFA, survive password resets and grant durable acc…

items.title: How APT41 revived the BlackLotus bootkit to attack diplomatic organizations in Central Asia
items.summary: Back in October 2022, Kaspersky GReAT was looking into a peculiar advertisement on a hacking forum. As no BlackLotus samples were found in the wild, no one could at the time verify the claims made in the forum post. items.title: Compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates
items.summary: Cisco Talos is aware of eight compromised intermediate certificates belonging to the intermediate certificate authority, eMudhra. Rather than possessing the mandatory 384 bits of pseudo-random security, several private keys evaluated single-digit and double-digit integers. This misconfiguration allows an attacker with the private key of any of the compromised intermediate CAs to impersonate any website or service. items.title: Muistatko tämän 90-luvun suosikkisarjan? Lukeutuu Ylen toivotuimpiin, mutta tällä hetkellä sitä ei voi katsoa mistään

items.summary: Sinfonista deathcorea ja melodista death metalia yhdistelevä Mental Cruelty on minulle hieman hankala tapaus. Saksalainen yhtye vaikuttaa kuitenkin olevan pienimuotoisessa nosteessa. Pahimmillaan seurauksena on julkista nöyryyttämistä ja kaveripiiristä ulos sulkemista. Ilmiö tunnetaan nimellä cancelointi , eikä se koske pelkästään julkisuuden henkilöitä. Mitä canceloida tarkoittaa? Canceloida tarkoittaa sitä, että henkilöön, yritykseen tai muuhun toimijaan kohdistetaan voimakasta paheksuntaa.
